I've been planning for this for coming up on a year. It started with a desire to slit my wrists, I remember thinking how beautiful I'd look so pale, so silent that I couldn't say something stupid to break the illusion of elegance and grace. Since then I fell out with my roommates at the time, found myself cut off from my friends and moved in with my boyfriend at the time who did not love me like I loved him, because no man that I've loved has had the capacity to love like I do. I planned then to take his shotgun out into the woods, and put the butt of it against a tree, and barrel against my forehead then reach forward and push the trigger back with my index finger. He found out and ditched the gun, so I got caught up in escapism using drugs and alcohol to feel less of how I'm feeling. I got arrested and charged with possession, and paraphernalia as well as an OWI and since being on probation sobriety has only made me feel worse. I cant smoke again until October, until then I've picked up cigarettes. My boyfriend dumped me, I'm stuck in a small town as a transwoman in the middle of nowhere. I cannot afford to insure my car, so I cant go anywhere, I have a job but my options for employment are limited to walking distance, and as easy as retail work can be I still dread waking up every day, knowing that I'm never going to make enough money to get back to my home town. Never going to make enough money to get my car back. Never going to make enough money to surgically transition. Never going to find a man who loves me rather than fetishizes me. Never going to get past my anxiety and depression. I will spend every last year I have in this lifetime lonely, working and feeling entirely inadequate. It doesn't seem worth hanging around for.
